questions: FOR THE LEAD FIRST, THE BRIDGE DECK'S HEIGHTS: the lead's note asked for an H_profile_X built from the bridge kit's table. It cannot give this deck's heights, so the frame does not use it. With S3's measured knots the bridge's axis (foot se (18810, 1090) to foot ne (20025, 396)) runs 50.6 deg from east (checks), and the deck's width lies east-west in the picture with its heights level across it (the bridge agent).
